canonicalReference.description: A pointer to an external Canonical asset this Assessment does not own (Engagement Context, Attack Candidate, Assessment Method, Business Impact Model, Crosswalk, or another Canonical Source). 'version' is an opaque string — in this repository it is populated with a git commit hash by convention, but this schema does not hard-code Git as the mechanism (LUVIRA-ASA-008 §18).

asset_id.description: Identifier of the referenced Canonical asset (e.g. a document path, an Attack Candidate ID such as ASA-ATK-001, an Engagement Context ID).

version.description: Opaque version marker for the referenced asset as it existed at reference time (e.g. a git commit hash of the source document).

label.description: Optional human-readable label for this reference.
